b0_tfidf.note: Rows without fixed_files/modified_files/file ground truth are skipped for file-level metrics. Rows without fixed_symbols/function_name/class_name ground truth are skipped for symbol-level metrics.

symbol_evaluation_contract.module_rule: <module> only matches symbol_kind=module; module never matches non-module
symbol_evaluation_contract.missing_prediction_rule: retain in end-to-end denominator as a miss
symbol_evaluation_contract.multi_gold_rule: hit uses any gold; recall averages matched unique gold / all gold
symbol_evaluation_contract.candidate_rule: exact Hit/Recall@10/30 only when a gold file is in Stage-2 Top-5
symbol_evaluation_contract.coverage_rule: LLM valid/fallback/timeout rates use LLM-eligible rows
symbol_evaluation_contract.paired_rule: compare stage3_retrieval_symbols with stage3_ranked_symbols per ticket
symbol_evaluation_contract.bootstrap_rule: paired mean delta, 2000 resamples, deterministic seeds
